title: Knuth sees something fall into the sea through night-vision goggles

tellings.quote: but I actually saw something fall and hit the water in infrared.

plain: In 2021, looking through night-vision goggles off Laguna Beach, California, the physicist Kevin Knuth says he saw something fall from the sky and hit the water. Knuth, who has worked with NASA, tells it as his own sighting: "I actually saw something fall and hit the water in infrared." He offers it as a firsthand case of an unexplained object he saw with his own eyes.
